name: ogbn-mag
description: A heterogeneous academic graph from the Microsoft Academic Graph, with papers, authors, institutions, and fields of study as node types and typed relationships between them. The benchmark commonly uses paper nodes for subject-area classification.
citation: Hu, W., Fey, M., Zitnik, M., Dong, Y., Ren, H., Liu, B., Catasta, M., & Leskovec, J. (2020). Open Graph Benchmark: Datasets for Machine Learning on Graphs. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 33, 22118–22133. https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.00687
